title: Matterbridge xiao
description: Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20+ for Apple Home and Siri, through the `xiao web` REST API.

deviceName.description: Name of the vacuum in Apple Home (what you say to Siri).

token.description: X-Xiao-Token, only if `xiao web` runs with --token / XIAO_WEB_TOKEN (not needed on 127.0.0.1).

serverMode.description: Expose the vacuum as its own Matter node. Apple Home and Siri require this; leave it on.

pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to read the vacuum status (seconds, minimum 5).

roomNames.description: Optional per-room names for Siri, overriding the names from `xiao map rooms`.

zones.description: Named rectangles exposed as extra rooms ("Oye Siri, limpia el comedor"). Coords as in `xiao clean -z`.

debug.description: Enable the debug log for this plugin

unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
